policy: This file is the authoritative Amanda asset map. Do not create additional Amanda asset roots. Public presentation assets belong under public/amanda-catherine. Private paid-course files remain in Vercel Blob and must be referenced only through lib/amanda-catherine/course-resources.ts.

public.purpose: website, portal presentation, brand marks, approved imagery and non-private media

rules: No Amanda public image may be added outside public/amanda-catherine.
No private course document or paid-course video may be copied into public/.
Every private course asset must have exactly one resource-registry entry.
Legacy Amanda asset folders are non-canonical and must not be referenced by production code.
The client package at clients/amanda-catherine is the single lookup point for Amanda ownership and storage locations.
